messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 Pager: High error-rate on smart-routing fallback for model family 'redwood-large'. Affected routes: /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — paging oncall.

maria (oncall): on it. can someone paste the current routing policy?

sam (runtime): pinging smart-routing svc. giving the API: `GET /policy/smartroute/redwood-large`

sam (runtime): quick look: policy is set to prefer quant variants, with region-fallback enabled and auto-compat-check ON.

irina (ml-infra): that auto-compat-check is supposed to block variants missing toolcall support. I'm seeing the quantized variant (redwood-large-quant-v2) incorrectly flagged as compatible for toolcalling.

dave (sre): customers are seeing 502s and "unsupported tool call" errors, looks like requests are routing to quant variant that doesn't have toolcall hooks.

leo (support): we have 4 customer tickets from EU with examples, some show repeated retries and higher latency. No data exfil.

maria (oncall): impact scope? just EU?

sam (runtime): initial telemetry: 12% error rate in eu-west-1, retries cause repeated fallbacks — some requests loop between region fallback and variant fallback for ~3-10s before finally erroring.

irina (ml-infra): log snippet from model registry: `redwood-large-quant-v2.features: tool_call_support:false` but compat matrix has `tool_call_support:true` for that row. Looks like matrix ingestion script dropped a flag.

dave (sre): ok that's the root cause. smart-routing trusts the matrix, sends toolcall traffic to quant variant, variant returns unsupported -> routing triggers region fallback -> next region's smart-routing again picks the incompatible quant variant -> loop.

maria (oncall): mitigation options: 1) disable smart-routing globally 2) mark quant variant incompatible in policy 3) change fallback policy to FP16-only for toolcall routes. Thoughts?

sam (runtime): quickest low-risk: override the route rule for /v1/generate (tool_call=true) to prefer `redwood-large-fp16` and set `smart-routing.enabled=false` for that route. I can push a policy override now.

irina (ml-infra): we'll need to correct the compat matrix ingestion script but that's post-mortem. Right now we should block traffic to quant variant for any toolcall requests.

nina (product): customers using tool calling are high-value, prioritize. Need customer-facing note once we stabilize.

leo (support): I'll draft a short status blurb and tag customers with tickets.

maria (oncall): sam, do the override. dave, can you watch infra and revert if we see new regressions?

sam (runtime): applying override: `PATCH /policy/route/override` payload: ```{
  "route":"/v1/generate",
  "conditions": {"tool_call": true},
  "preferred_variants":["redwood-large-fp16"],
  "smart_routing": false
}```

deploy-bot: roll started by sam — override-policy v3 -> staging -> prod.

sam (runtime): override is live in eu-west-1. Monitoring now.

dave (sre): infra metrics: error rate down from 12% -> 1.4% over the last 90s, latency normalizing. No new region fallback cycles observed.

leo (support): sending status to customers: "We've identified routing to an incompatible quant variant as cause; traffic for tool-calls in EU routed to FP16 variant while we fix the compatibility matrix."

maria (oncall): great. capture the exact window and affected customers. sam, can you list the request_ids for failures so we can attach them to tickets?

sam (runtime): pulling failed request_ids now, will paste in a gist.

irina (ml-infra): immediate follow-ups: 1) revert bad ingest run, 2) add an assert in ingestion to fail if tool_call flag mismatch between storage and manifest, 3) run a quick audit of other families. I'll open PRs.

dave (sre): also recommend a temporary alert: if a variant responds with "unsupported tool call" more than X times in Y minutes, block it in routing automatically. reduces similar blast radius.

nina (product): add a customer-impact severity note: "Partial degraded service for tool-calling endpoints in eu-west-1 for ~20 minutes, affecting a subset of requests with programmatic tool calls; mitigated by routing override."

leo (support): customers notified. a few asked for ETA on permanent fix. I said ETA after infra PR and matrix re-ingest.

maria (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay on for 15 more minutes to confirm stability, then hand to morning oncall. Please attach the PR links and rollback steps in the incident doc.

sam (runtime): gist with failed request_ids: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcdef123456 (contains 120 request IDs).

irina (ml-infra): opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/ml-infra/pull/242 — adds ingestion assert and a unit test. I'm scheduling a reingest in a canary region after tests pass.

dave (sre): logging follow-up: add route-level telemetry to show variant selection and compat reason, so we don't have to dig logs next time. I'll take that on.

maria (oncall): okay handoff: @sam please include the policy override ID in the incident doc, @irina include the PR and reingest plan, @dave include alert rule PR. I'll summarize and hand to morning oncall at 08:00 UTC.

sam (runtime): override ID: `override-20240303-17f2`.

leo (support): adding customer ticket numbers to the incident doc: #3241, #3244, #3250, #3261.

maria (oncall): closing pager — system stable, error rate <1.5% sustained for 10m. real RCA tomorrow. Good job team. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Pager resolved: oncall acknowledged and mitigation applied.

maria (oncall): follow-ups for the RCA: timeline, why ingestion dropped the flag, tests to catch regressions, a playbook entry for variant-incompat fallbacks, and customer comms template. I'll create the incident doc and assign owners.

irina (ml-infra): I'll run a full family audit overnight and post results in the incident doc.

dave (sre): I'll draft the alert and the telemetry PR.

sam (runtime): I'll keep the override for 24h while reingest completes, then we'll switch back once confirmed.

nina (product): I'll prepare a postmortem summary for impacted customers and stakeholder comms.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. handing off to morning oncall.

--- end thread ---
